title: Seaview Hotel Completes Renovation
L: After eight months of work, the Seaview Hotel has completed a major renovation.
All 120 guest rooms now feature new furniture and larger bathrooms.
Each room also has a new desk for business travelers.
The hotel's restaurant has also been redesigned and now offers stunning views of the bay.
General manager Paul Dubois said the project was finished on time and within budget.
"Our guests have been very patient," he said.
"Therefore, we are offering a 20 percent discount on all bookings made this month." The hotel expects its rooms to be fully booked throughout the summer.

exq.a: Each room also has a new desk for business travelers.
w: The hotel's summer rates will be announced in May.
Paul Dubois has worked in hotels for twenty years.
The summer season usually starts in June.
exq.why: Câu trước tả phòng (nội thất, phòng tắm) → câu chèn thêm một chi tiết về phòng (bàn làm việc mới).
Trước danh từ views cần tính từ: stunning (tuyệt đẹp).
Khách đã kiên nhẫn → vì vậy có ưu đãi: Therefore.
Bổ nghĩa cho booked (phân từ) cần trạng từ: fully booked.
